scope: Independent pinned original-host first-start ticket and irreversible claim before local dispatch; actual Windows protected machine/principal/storage origin, continued ACL verification; direct full custody consistency with Kernel and fixed-check admission wrapping. Production driver/full model/account/quota/recovery remain separate and default closed.

environment.dependency_install: D-233 frozen lock installation; no dependency or lock change.
environment.git: main; refreshed origin/main e789902379534c6e36ea6ebc14266ed5167b761c; main ahead4 before batch commit; no reset/clean/push/force push.

implementation.ledger: Independent private format1. Explicit NEW root initialization, no missing-original repair; random ledger ID, actual machine/principal/path/directory/database file identity. Pinned original ticket before Context; immutable run/operation claim before local dispatch, no release/retry API.
implementation.integrity: Exact SQLite DDL/immutable triggers/application_id/user_version, quick_check/FK/full row canonical bytes/digests/counts; integrity checks in a single read or write transaction snapshot.
implementation.windows: Actual Windows MachineGuid digest via existing native clock; SID digest only. Exact root owner/protected one SID FullControl/child inheritance, database/WAL/SHM/journal same owner inherited-only ACL checked on each origin assertion. No principal names/keys/script stderr exported.
implementation.runtime: Service explicitly checks own full custody plus Kernel equal host_validation_digest; missing/partial registration or ledger/ACL/structure/identity drift denies or retains Unknown. Actual Native unique-start path retained.
implementation.checks: Start wrapper is independently unwrapped by concrete trusted custody, then original checks subsystem revalidates unchanged fixed admission/Node/policy/harness/catalog. Manual install rejects both check and start wrappers.
implementation.capacity_boundary: 1024 tickets,4096 claims,65536-byte encoded record; initializer max_page_count16384, FULL/WAL. Not total Runtime physical/WAL/history capacity or approved money/points budget.
implementation.trust_boundary: No external anti-rollback proof against privileged original host administrator or in-place old-backup restoration; full original recovery remains required. Ledger cannot qualify Provider/model/account, settle fees or prove terminal business success.

behavior_red.boundary: Actual constructed Kernel callback allows start without independent original host ledger before fix; one behavior assertion fails, other assertions filtered, no Native process/model evidence.
